title: Switzerland's first spot Bitcoin ETF starts trading on SIX
description: BIT Asset Management's Bitcoin Fund ETF began trading on SIX Swiss Exchange with 350 bitcoin in assets after FINMA approved the fund in October.

title: Braiins Says Bitcoin Mining Hijacks Hit More Than 1,000 Sites at Once
description: Bitcoin mining pool Braiins reported that attackers rerouted traffic to unsecured mining connections in 24 incidents between Nov. 7 and Nov. 20, with four episodes on Nov. 20 each affecting 1,050 to 1,600 sites.

title: Swiss Federal Council approves 57 partners for crypto tax data exchange from 2028
description: Switzerland's Federal Council approved 57 jurisdictions for automatic exchange of cryptoasset tax data starting in 2028 under the OECD reporting framework.

title: UK Court Enters Default Judgment Against Two in X Bitcoin Account Case
description: London's High Court entered judgment for X against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa on Nov. 20 after neither responded to the creator-payout fraud claim, with damages to be fixed at a later hearing.

title: Bithumb says October breach ran 15 days and exposed passports and wallet addresses
description: In a Nov. 25 update, Bithumb said intruders had its internal groupware for about 15 days, not one hour, and that up to 19 categories of personal data were taken.
